en.title: How much fresh snow in Mayrhofen next week: 2–31 cm at the top (23–29 November)
en.description: Mayrhofen snow forecast for 23–29 November 2026: 17 cm at the top (2–31 cm), 1 cm at the base, snowiest day Sunday 29 November, with neighbours compared.
en.lede: Sunday 29 November is the day to circle for Mayrhofen. It carries the biggest single share of next week's snow, and over the whole week of 23–29 November the top around 2400 m collects 17 cm (2–31 cm) while the base gets 1 cm.

sections.h: How the week of 23–29 November adds up in Mayrhofen
p: At the top (around 2400 m) the week totals 17 cm, 2–31 cm across our range. Mid-mountain around 1500 m gets 14 cm (2–25 cm), and the base around 700 m almost nothing (1 cm) (0–2 cm).

Day by day, the upper mountain picks up most of it on Monday 23 (3 cm, up to 5), Wednesday 25 (2 cm, up to 5), Friday 27 (4 cm, up to 6) and Sunday 29 (5 cm, up to 10). Outside those days expect little more than flurries.

sections.h: Where the good snow will be
p: Sunday 29 November brings the most, 5 cm at the top and 10 cm at best: enough to soften the pistes, not enough for a powder day.

Go high: depth is safest on the Penken and the Ahorn, with the Hintertux glacier up the valley, and the best skiing should be on the Penken's shaded side. Treat Mayrhofen down in the Zillertal valley as the weak point.

sections.h: Snow or rain at the bottom?
p: Don't judge Mayrhofen from the village. With 1 cm at the bottom and 17 cm at the top, the lower runs are near or under the snow line, and much of what falls there may be rain.
Mayrhofen's valley floor is low, so most of the week's snow there will be about the upper Penken.
At the top, next week, our forecast gives Hintertux (13 km away) 14 cm, Kitzbühel (52 km away) 18 cm and Stubai Glacier (54 km away) 14 cm, against 17 cm here.
Nothing to separate them on snow alone; the choice comes down to the terrain you want.
Unlike the French side of the Alps, Mayrhofen sees only 8 cm up high from 17 to 20 November (4–12 cm). So next week's snow is most of the fortnight's story here.
Low. At the top our forecast spans 2 to 31 cm: one version of the week brings a decent fall, the other almost nothing. Check again midweek before committing.
The days closest to now are the most reliable; the end of the week is the least.

advice: Before leaving the pistes in Mayrhofen, check the regional avalanche service of the province.
Opening dates are the resort's call; our numbers only say how much snow is coming.
Pack for wet weather in the village: the 1 cm at the base hides a lot of rain.
